disclaimer: Synthetic demonstration form, not an official scholarship document.

what_to_enter.en: Enter your full legal name as printed on the identity document the form asks for.
what_to_enter.hi: Jo pehchan patra form maangta hai, usi par chhapa poora kanooni naam likhen.
what_to_enter.kn: Form keluva gurutina dakhalealli iruva poorna kanoonu hesaranu baredi.

why_needed.en: The office uses this to identify the student.
why_needed.hi: Chatra ki pehchan ke liye naam maanga gaya hai.

what_to_enter.en: Enter your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format.
what_to_enter.hi: Apni janm tithi DD/MM/YYYY praroop mein likhen.
what_to_enter.kn: Nimma janma dinankavannu DD/MM/YYYY svaroopadalli baredi.

why_needed.en: Age or eligibility checks may use this date. Verify official rules.
why_needed.hi: Aayu jaanch ke liye tithi ho sakti hai. Adhikarik niyam dekhen.
why_needed.kn: Vayassina padyarigagi dinanka beku. Adhikrita niyamagala parishilisi.

what_to_enter.en: Enter the name of the school or college printed on your ID card.
what_to_enter.hi: Apne ID card par chhapa school ya college ka naam likhen.
what_to_enter.kn: Nimma ID cardnalli iruva shaale athava kalejiya hesaru baredi.

why_needed.en: The form routes the application to an institution.
why_needed.hi: Aavedan sanstha tak pahunchane ke liye.

what_to_enter.en: Enter the course or programme name you are applying from.
what_to_enter.hi: Jis course se aavedan kar rahe hain uska naam likhen.
what_to_enter.kn: Neevu arji maaduttiruva pathyakramada hesaru baredi.

why_needed.en: The scholarship office groups applications by course.
why_needed.hi: Course ke anusaar aavedan jode jaate hain.

what_to_enter.en: Enter marks or percentage exactly as on the mark sheet.
what_to_enter.kn: Ankapatradalli iruva pramanakke sariyagi anka baredi.

why_needed.en: This demo form uses marks to rank applications.
why_needed.hi: Yeh demo form ankdon se kram nikalta hai.

what_to_enter.en: Mark the box only if you agree with the printed declaration.
what_to_enter.hi: Tabhi box chinhit karen jab aap chhape ghoshna se sahmat hon.

why_needed.en: Records that the student reviewed the statement.
why_needed.hi: Chatra ne kathan padha yeh darj karta hai.

what_to_enter.en: Leave this blank in FormSathi. Sign the official paper form by hand.
what_to_enter.hi: Yahan FormSathi mein kuch na likhen. Asli form par haath se hastakshar karen.
what_to_enter.kn: FormSathiyalli idannu khali bidi. Adhikrita formnalli kaiyinda sahi maadi.

why_needed.en: Sign the official paper after checking every answer.
why_needed.hi: Har uttar jaanchkar asli kagaz par hastakshar karen.
why_needed.kn: Prati uttara parishilisi adhikrita kaagadadalli sahi maadi.
